name: nexfit
description: NEXFIT · tienda de ropa deportiva — frontend React + backend TypeScript

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend
